name: pi-subagents-v2
description: Persistent subagents for Pi: long-lived agent identities with durable memory (Pi-native session JSONL under the project's sessions dir), disk-backed mailboxes with a single envelope contract (message/question/answer/report/escalation/error), team-scoped peer communication, markdown+frontmatter type definitions (project overrides global), get-or-create spawn, oneshot lifetimes with archive + N-day GC, and a session-viewer TUI.
